scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd src/client tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && bun run --cwd src/server tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd src/client tsc --noEmit -p ../../tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.lint: bun --bun biome check src/ tests/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: bun --bun biome check --write src/ tests/ playwright.config.ts
scripts.setup: cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo 'pre-commit hook installed'
